content: Yehoba Samuwela I Yogaan
Geman Samuwela i totuwalali Yehoba kaiwena Ilai wana logugui gabulanaa. He saugena o elana, baaba toto i nonoem Yehoba elana ge wana pankite nige i gangan hot boda Isileli elal.
Ilai matana iyaka i pwepweyata nawa nige bosowaina bugul ni kite bubun. Bulin etega iya iyoho i kenukenu wana abakenuwa,
ge geman Samuwela iyoho i kenu Yehoba wana limi gamwanaa, toto Yehoba wana Bateli ana Dedewaga hi teliya. He mweluluga kekeisi Limi Bwabwalena ana odam nige ga hi papabolu,
yaka Yehoba i yoga i ba, “Samuwela!” Inoke anana i lahe i ba, “O, nau iyahe.”
Yaka i lut i tapalelu i na Ilai elana ge i ba, “Tonowak! U yogaagau, he nau hiwe.” Anana Ilai i lahe i ba, “Nige ya yoyogaagiwa, u sikal u na u kenu.” Inoke Samuwela i sikal ge i na i kenu.
Yaka Yehoba i yoga al i ba, “Samuwela!” Yaka Samuwela i lut i na Ilai elana ge i ba, “Tonowak! U yogaagau, he nau hiwe.” Anana Ilai i lahe i ba, “Natu, nige ya yoyogaagiwa, u sikal u na u kenu.”
He Samuwela nigeya ga Yehoba i aatena, kaiwena nige sauga etega i baaba elana ge i hahago.
Inoke Yehoba i yoga paetonina, yaka Samuwela i lut i na Ilai elana ge i ba, “Tonowak! U yogaagau, he nau hiwe.” Inoke abwe Ilai i nuwatu Yehoba te geman Samuwela i yogaan.
Yaka i baek elana i ba, “U sikal u na u kenu. Ebo ni yogaagiwa al, yaka nu talam nu ba, ‘Yehoba, u ba na hago, nau wam totuwalali ya laegan-agiwa.’” Yaka Samuwela i sikal i na i kenu abanaa.
Inoke Yehoba i na i talmilila Samuwela gegelinaa ge i yoga i ola wana yoga bolo houwa, i ba, “Samuwela! Samuwela!” Yaka anana i lahe i ba, “U ba na hago, nau wam totuwalali ya laegan-agiwa.”
Inoke Yehoba i baek elana i ba, “Bugul etega ya giginol boda Isileli gamwaliyaa, inoke wasana nihi hago ge nuwaliya nihi ahe.
Lan o, lahi toto ya baunan Ilai ana tini kaiweliya, gegewena na ginol paolaolaek.
Iyaka ya baek elana te lahi mihomihotina na ginol ana tini elana, kaiwena natunau wali ginol i bwaikikin matawa. He Ilai i atena ya, yaa nige i papaveyahol.
Inoke ya papasila Ilai ana tini kaiweliya te nige powon o ebo mulolu etega bosowaina ge wali gegi ni yakil yoho.”
Samuwela i kenu ana siga mweluluga, yaka i lut ge Yehoba wana limi ana nog i pwela. Yaa i lovakun te Yehoba hauna i baunan ana pankite elana ni wasaan Ilai elana.
Yaka Ilai i yoga elana i ba, “Samuwela, natu.” Anana i lahe i ba, “O, nau iyahe.”
Yaka Ilai i baek elana i ba, “Yehoba ga i ba ola eliyam? Bahi nu aalahan eliyau. Ebo bugul etega nu sume eliyau, he Yehoba lahi pupulowanina hot ni ginol eliyam.”
Inoke Samuwela bugul gegewena i wasaan eliyana, nige etega i aalahan. Yaka Ilai i ba, “Iya Yehoba, hauna toto i waisi matanaa, he ni ginol ya.”
He Samuwela i bwabwata nawa, Yehoba i minaa elana ge i labe wana baaba gegewena nige etega i tatabwa bugul bwagabwaga.
Yaka Isileli gegewel, i telipunaa aluwabwa un Dani wali labiya i na ana siga yavanaa Biyaseba ana labiya, hi atena te Samuwela iya Yehoba wana palopita etega.
He Yehoba i mimi masamasal Samuwela elana panuwa Sailo ge wana baaba i babaunan elana.
